propositions: Outcome labels must be derived from store signals alone (verdict flips, defect close classes, caused_by links, completion failures, reopens) without LLM/human annotation
Finding-level labels distinguish persisted, resolved_by_author, and noise_flip outcomes by comparing consecutive cache rows keyed to material_fingerprint and norm_id
Ticket-level labels identify escaped_defect, completion_failed_after_pass, reopened, force_close, and clean_close status by querying STATUS/COMMENT/COMPLETION_VERDICT events with environment override
Noise floor is computed as verdict flip rate, per-criterion churn (1 - Jaccard similarity), and per-question Pass-2 agreement on verification keys, pooled across all identical-material pairs
Labels are keyed to corpus content_hash and refuse to load if the hash mismatches the supplied labels file
Unverified corpus rows must never enter any label output; all findings filtered through sidecar.surfaced_findings() before norm_id joins
